exposure: Type of preterm delivery (spontaneous vs indicated)
Vaginal delivery at term in the first pregnancy
Term cesarean delivery in the first pregnancy
cohort: Women with the first 2 consecutive singleton deliveries between 2007-2014 from a single institution.
finding: After adjusting for confounders, term cesarean delivery in the first pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery (overall, spontaneous, or indicated) in the subsequent pregnancy.
mod_finding: After adjusting for confounders, cesarean delivery was not associated with an increase in preterm delivery, whether spontaneous or indicated, in the subsequent pregnancy.
